value.rationale: The product involution completes a natural four-element symmetry action on a homologically difficult infinite family. Odd/even folds have structurally distinct seam compatibilities and sign corrections, not a routine substitution of one reflection formula. The resulting quotient Euler characteristic for every width, for example -51 at width 17, is an intrinsic topological invariant unavailable from earlier nonequivariant ranks or the two separate reflection traces.
